text:
Jamie (People Ops): quick ask — assembling a tiny pack of one-line impact headlines + habit prompts managers can paste into OKR check-ins and self-reviews. want these to be low-friction and usable in slack/1:1s. sharing first pass, pls react and add tweaks :slightly_smiling_face:

Alex H: love this. quick rules i used: 1) one sentence impact headline, 2) 1 short evidence line, 3) optional next-step/habit. examples below (paste-ready):

• Impact headline: Reduced inference p50 latency by 18% across production models.
  Evidence: Tuned batching + updated kernel selection; measured via /console/latency dashboard (Q1 baseline).
  Habit/Next-step: Add a weekly 15m 'pipeline health' check with infra to catch regressions.

• Impact headline: Increased self-serve signups conversion from experiment to prod by 12%.
  Evidence: Deployed optimized onboarding flow A/B; tracked cohort conversion in Amplitude.
  Habit/Next-step: Block 1 day/month for onboarding design reviews.

• Impact headline: Cut per-token inference cost by 9% for conversational workload.
  Evidence: Adopted 8-bit quantization and cache-friendly batching on dedicated pool.
  Habit/Next-step: Create a quantization playbook and train two engineers.

Maya R: adding a short set of manager micro-prompts for coaching during check-ins — these are 1-line starters you can say out loud or paste:

• "Tell me one thing you shipped this cycle that you're proud of."
• "What's the one thing blocking your momentum this week?"
• "How did this work move the needle on customer or cost metrics?"

Samir: self-review starter bullets for ICs (short, copyable):

• "I drove X by doing Y; measured impact = Z."
• "Biggest challenge: _____; I addressed it by _____ and learned _____."
• "Goal alignment: this ties to OKR <objective> because <why>."

Jamie (People Ops): tiny rubric for managers to quickly score and comment (use in 1:1 or form):

• Impact: (High/Medium/Low) — one-line justification.
• Ownership: (Full/Partial/Support) — one-line example.
• Growth Opportunity: one concrete habit suggestion (e.g., "pair for code ownership 1x/wk").

HR Bot: Deploy tip: use the following slack snippet to request a quick pre-1:1 self-review (paste into dm):
```
Hey <name> — could you drop a 1–2 line impact headline and one blocker before our 1:1? Example:
- Impact: Reduced inference p50 by 18% (tuned batching).
- Blocker: need time for quantization playbook.
Thanks!
```

Alex H: also — for OKRs, encourage 'metric + timeframe' in the headline (e.g., "Increase NPS by 4 pts by EOY"). prevents vague statements.

Maya R: formatting tip for forms: bold the headline, small italic evidence line, then 1-line habit. keeps review pages scannable.

Samir: tiny example manager comment (paste-ready):
"Great ownership on the latency work — impact clear and measurable. Suggest pairing with infra to make the playbook repeatable; next check-in: progress on training two engineers. :thumbsup:"

Jamie (People Ops): perfect. i'll fold these into a one-pager and add a short copy for the internal docs page. if anyone has 1 quick additional example or a concise anti-pattern (what *not* to write) please drop it here.

Alex H: anti-pattern — "worked on infra improvements" (no metric, no timeframe).

Maya R: anti-pattern — long chronological logs instead of impact + evidence. keeps reviewers exhausted.

Jamie (People Ops): thanks all — will post the one-pager and a slack-ready pack later today. :raised_hands:
